Upgrade Group

UI component for displaying and managing upgrade selection interfaces.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
{
  "upgradeGroup": {}
}

Description

The Upgrade Group component displays and manages upgrade selection interfaces. It presents available upgrades to the player and handles the selection process, commonly used for level-up screens, skill trees, and perk selection menus.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
Upgrade options and layout are configured through UI properties.

Example

JSON
{
  "upgradeGroup": {}
}
